earlier_supplement_passes.note: Earlier supplement pass retained, including rejected mixed award-type group performer searches. Fixed by querying contract and assistance groups separately.

initial_pass_metadata_loss.action: First unscoped live verification pass queried PIID FD01 without known parent, retrieving unrelated same-PIID records. Corrected by parent-scoped rerun.
initial_pass_metadata_loss.reason: The initial in-memory request ledger was overwritten by the completed scoped rerun before backup; the attempted backup was a duplicate of the scoped log and has been removed from request counts.
initial_pass_metadata_loss.outcome: Known metadata loss; no complete all-attempt request count is claimed. Final award/action register only uses parent-scoped reconciled records.
initial_pass_metadata_loss.response_bodies: Private cached response bodies retained; unmatched body hash inventory and inferred URLs below. Same-response overwrites mean this is unique bodies, not count of actual requests. No paid API used.
